meta_description:
16K likes, 292 comments - thefitnesschef_ on October 21, 2026: "These plates of spaghetti bolognese appear identical as they have the exact same volume. 🍝

However, one plate contains 1000 calories and the other 635.

If you swap 200g of regular beef mince for the same quantity of 5% fat beef mince - you save 250 calories without losing volume or taste.

If you reduce the olive oil used from 20ml to 5ml - you save an additional 135 calories while still lubricating the pan.

These two extremely simple swaps reduce the plate by 385 calories to support a calorie deficit better.

Losing fat is not achieved through extreme actions. Instead, it is achieved by making adherence to a calorie deficit as easy as possible over long periods of time. ✅

#spaghetti #caloriedeficit #lowcalories".
